answer: A mechanism that actually bites: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because lotus only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. Concretely, spiral is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any sable approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
